name: Tuttle Twins
description: The Tuttle Twins show, based on the best-selling books, is the first of its kind cartoon series that aims to instruct while entertaining.

videos.title: Dark Dumpster Derek Returns
videos.overview: You can’t put a price on this golden mini-episode of Tuttle Twins. The twins are filming an exciting new Dark Dumpster Derek adventure, in which our beloved masked hero takes on the gold-hungry Worm Burglar. Ethan and Emily pay a visit to George Washington and learn about the history of gold as money in the US, and how owning and using gold is far more doable than they think—even for kids!

videos.title: Cabrini: A Tuttle Twins Adventure
videos.overview: When the twins are hoping for a selfish Saturday, they are whisked away to meet Francesca Cabrini who helps them understand compassion and the impact of selfless acts.

videos.title: Solving Selfishness: A Karinne and Copernicus Adventure
videos.overview: During a game of hide and seek, Karinne and Copernicus steal Grandma's wheelchair on a quest to find Karinne's idol, Karl Marx. Along the way, Karinne begins to question whether self interest is really as bad as it sounds.

videos.title: Young Washington: A Tuttle Twins Adventure
videos.overview: Ethan and Emily are ready to quit after their new movie falls apart. Grandma Gabby resolves to help the twins get back on their feet, taking them on a journey to learn about resilience from a man who triumphed over incredible odds: Founding Father and first President George Washington. Guest starring Congressman Nick Freitas.

videos.title: Helmuth Hübener: A Tuttle Twins Adventure
videos.overview: The twins’ entire gym class gets carried away by the gym teacher's immoral assignment. But then Emily and Ethan meet brave teens from WWII Germany, who teach them the importance of speaking truth to power.

videos.title: Homestead: A Tuttle Twins Adventure
videos.overview: During family movie night, a power outage unexpectedly transports Grandma and the twins into the post-apocalyptic world of Homestead to learn an action-packed lesson in emergency preparedness.

videos.title: Tax Holiday Special!
videos.overview: Happy Tax Day! When the twins get their first real paychecks, they’re shocked to learn how much is taken back with taxes. Grandma takes them into the School House Pop cartoon where they learn a fan-tax-ical lesson.

videos.title: Schwartz Shorts
videos.overview: What starts as a simple favor turns into a sleepless night when Lt. Schwartz agrees to babysit Derek. Trapped in a whirlwind of five unexpected lessons, he’s taken on a crash course through daylight savings, Social Security, and more. By sunrise, he’s not sure what he signed up for… or what time it is.

videos.title: The Cost Of Cuckoo Laws
videos.overview: A noisy neighbor’s endless clocks drive the twins to take drastic action. But their solution comes with unintended consequences. When they turn to government force to solve the problem, they learn just how costly and dangerous that power can be. As a vengeful cyclops closes in, Ethan and Emily must reckon with what they’ve done and find a better way to resolve conflict—before time runs out.

videos.title: Fairies & Figuring It Out
videos.overview: Ethan wants to give up on a difficult project—until Grandma casts a spell that turns him into a puppet. Now under the watchful eye of the Do Fairy, he must learn the value of taking initiative and finishing what he starts.

videos.title: It’s a Wonderful Wage
videos.overview: After the twins wish the minimum wage was raised, Grandma grants the wish in a classic movie parody twist. With the help of a guardian economist, Milton Friedman, the twins realize that a minimum wage has a lot of unintended consequences.

videos.title: When Laws Give You Lemons
videos.overview: When Grandma Gabby moves in with the Tuttle Twins, she takes her twin grandkids on a wheelchair time machine to France and the Old West to learn about laws and try to save their lemonade stand. By learning about the principles Frédéric Bastiat writes in his groundbreaking book, The Law, the twins are able to save their stand!

videos.title: War of the Worms
videos.overview: A science camp rivalry threatens to destroy Emily’s dreams. Grandma takes the twins to India and a worm battlefield to learn about the golden rule before it’s too late. By learning about the golden rule of fiscal policy, the twins are able to save Emily’s dreams!

videos.title: Pencils, Pirates & Ice Cream People
videos.overview: Argh! The twins encounter space pirates, a Scotsman, and ice cream people as they learn about free trade and why no one can make a pencil by themselves.

videos.title: Of Business and Benjamins
videos.overview: With the help of Ben Franklin, the Twins learn what it means to be an entrepreneur and start their own corndog stand. By learning about entrepreneurship, the twins are able to grow a business… Too bad Karinnie has some business plans of her own.

videos.title: Rising Tides & Dirty Deals
videos.overview: The Twins learn that big businesses like Big Bob's BBQ can sometimes produce laws that keep smaller businesses like Food Trucks from being able to survive. They visit Atlantis and try to stop the protectionism there before things get too wet.

videos.title: The Inflation Monster
videos.overview: Why does your money increasingly lose its value? With their eyes set on a big carnival prize, Ethan and Emily learn that printing more tickets causes prices to rise. They visit Ancient Rome and Modern Zimbabwe to see the Inflation Monster at work then rush back to save the carnival.

videos.title: Cakes, Pies, & Flat Earth Guys
videos.overview: Even though everyone learned a lot and some people got delicious desserts, Derek is the real winner of this episode, because he found love.

videos.title: Wonky Wages
videos.overview: Why doesn't everyone get equal pay? Join Ethan and Emily as they travel back in time to visit people like Babe Ruth and learn about the economic value that people provide.

videos.title: Dumpsters & Disobedience
videos.overview: Ethan and Emily’s film set gets shut down because of a dumb regulation. The twins learn about civilly disobeying unjust laws with the help of Rosa Parks and a funny Boat-Dweller named Doug. This Episode features Dark Dumpster Derek.

videos.title: Roll for Power
videos.overview: The Twins learn how surrendering powers to the government during times of calamity almost always results in long-term loss of freedoms. They play a fantastical game "Crisis & Creatures" and learn how to rely on the community rather than the government to help each other through challenging times.

videos.title: Free Speech Freestyle
videos.overview: Karinne is back to causing trouble and this time she’s spreading lies about Ethan. But, with the help of James Madison, the Twins learn what happens when you restrict free speech even if it’s mean or deceptive. This is a hip-hoppin’ episode so start warming up your voice for some Free Speech Freestyle!

videos.title: The Fate of the Future
videos.overview: Desperate to save Grandma Gabby, Ethan and Emily are thrust into a future world where the government runs every part of daily life. Tune in for the epic finale of season 1, an adventure about persuasion vs force as the twins fight for the future.

videos.title: Needs, Rights and Flamingo Fights
videos.overview: When a field trip goes wrong, the twins question if needs are actually rights. They learn about natural rights from John Locke and fight for their lives on an island of ferocious flamingos.

videos.title: Don't Trash Success
videos.overview: When the twins hit the jackpot with a trash can cleaning business, Karinne makes them question if success is selfish. They learn about true entrepreneurship from Joyce Chen and the grumpy Gurmbledons of Grumbletown!

videos.title: Bitcoin and the Beast
videos.overview: Holy Satoshi! When the twins are forced to choose between accepting dollars and bitcoin at a garage sale, they travel through the internet and a retro video game to learn what makes money well…good.

videos.title: Think Outside the Flocks
videos.overview: After their softball team starts bending the rules, the twins jump through famous paintings, meet George Washington, and try to save a divided farm from a big bad wolf and dangerous tribalism!

videos.title: A T-Rex and Tangled Ideas
videos.overview: After a T-rex destroys their treehouse, the twins struggle to save Rapunzel’s cramped kingdom and discover that good ideas can come from imperfect people.

videos.title: The Itsy Bitsy Victim Mentality
videos.overview: When the twins are unfairly cut from a talent show, Grandma takes them to meet Frederick Douglass and an itsy bitsy spider to learn how to conquer victim mentality.

videos.title: Wrestling with Socialism
videos.overview: LUCHA! After a failed kids club fundraiser, the gang runs into William Bradford, the pilgrims, and Karl Marx as they wrestle with socialism and its consequences.

videos.title: The Education Jungle
videos.overview: After Emily fails a test, the twins wonder whether school is the best way to learn--prompting Grandma to whisk them off to a familiar place in the past, before stopping by the most famous mind in history, and then a rumble in the jungle...

videos.title: Kidnappers & Capitalism
videos.overview: Invaders from another world kidnap Derek, launching Grandma and the twins on a dangerous rescue mission. On a dark planet, the twins encounter mysterious clues, cyborgs and spy gadgets as they solve the mystery of why capitalism is failing.

videos.title: Money Management Mayhem: A Christmas Adventure
videos.overview: When the twins argue about saving money versus spending it, Grandma Gabby introduces them to a board game that unleashes creatures and chaos into the Tuttle's home.

videos.title: The College Conundrum
videos.overview: The twins discover a crucial life lesson when they meet the legendary Mike Rowe, who emphasizes that not all careers require a college degree.

videos.title: Fighting for Fatherhood
videos.overview: The twins travel to a magical island with Dr. Ben Carson to learn about the fatherless epidemic.

videos.title: Cracking Conspiracies
videos.overview: GUEST STARRING Ashley St. Clair and Seamus Coughlin - When field day is mysteriously canceled, conspiracies abound! Ethan and Emily visit JFK to learn about critical thinking and then crack the conspiracy about what really happened to Humpty Dumpty.

videos.title: Evil Queens & Spying Screens
videos.overview: The cul-de-sac kids discover Karinne has gained access to their private digital lives! The Twins get a lesson in digital privacy from a mysterious guide, then rush to rescue Prince Charming from the Not-Evil Queen's digital control!

videos.title: A Bitcoin Bash & Corrupted Cash
videos.overview: When inflation wrecks movie night, Grandma takes the twins—and stowaway Karinne—back to the Bitcoinverse. There, they learn about the risks of controlled money, CBDCs, and the freedom of Bitcoin. Plus, rocks. Lots of rocks.

videos.title: Soccer Fights & Religious Rights
videos.overview: GUEST STARRING Adassa - The cul-de-sac kids are ready for a big soccer game, but when Kevin can’t play due to a religious holiday, Karinne votes to kick him off. With guidance from unexpected sources, the twins learn the value of religious freedom.

videos.title: Close Encounters of the Judgy Kind
videos.overview: During a gym class dodgeball game, a new kid creates chaos by judging others on appearance. Emily and Ethan turn to Grandma, who introduces them to Martin Luther King Jr., teaching them the value of character over judgment.

videos.title: Meatball Smears & War Profiteers
videos.overview: The twins visit President Eisenhower to learn about the military industrial complex.

videos.title: Flying Through Failure
videos.overview: The twins learn the value of failure from the Wright brothers and a world afraid to fail.

videos.title: Ruins and Responsibility
videos.overview: Sep transforms into a monster and sends the twins to a ruined alternate world, where they uncover the dangers of irresponsibility. With help from their not-grandmother, they inspire change and prove that true freedom comes from taking responsibility.

videos.title: The Rollercoaster of Charity
videos.overview: When the twins earn a trip to Bird Land Amusement Park, they discover that some charities do more harm than good. With help from friends, they must learn to give better—before the park shuts down forever!

videos.title: Melting Money & Fancy Fridges
videos.overview: When the Tuttle family debates buying a fancy new fridge, the twins meet John Maynard Keynes, Saifedean Ammous, and a world of quirky food. Together, they discover the hidden risks of melting money and thinking only in the short term.

videos.title: Cars, Cafes & Creative Destruction
videos.overview: After a machine threatens the twins’ jobs, they travel to 1920s Michigan to learn from Henry Ford about creative destruction. But when they return home, nothing is quite as they left it.

videos.title: Elves & Equity
videos.overview: After Emily unfairly loses a pie bake-off, the twins turn to Thomas Sowell to learn the dangers of equity, only to be swept into a fantastical world of elves, orcs, and basketball!

videos.title: Playing with Price Controls
videos.overview: After a price hike puts a new board game out of reach, the twins travel to Russia to learn about price controls. With economist Ludwig von Mises and a very persistent Copernicus, they discover why controlling prices can backfire.

videos.title: Hunger Pains & Media Games
videos.overview: After a suspicious news story airs, Grandma and the twins rescue Benjamin Franklin Bache but become trapped in a world where speaking out leads to deadly consequences. They must use journalism and the power of truth to fight back and survive.

videos.title: Food Lies & Battle Cries
videos.overview: When the Tuttles enter a fitness competition sponsored by a questionable food company, their health quickly declines. As Ethan's health spirals, Emily searches for answers about nutrition, with guideance from guest star Mikhaila Peterson.

videos.title: Dinos & Dependency
videos.overview: When the local library faces closure, Grandma take the twins to learn from Alexis de Tocqueville about the strength of community. But after a time tunnel mishap turns them into dinosaurs, survival depends on teamwork.

videos.title: Dark Dumpster Derek and the Gold Grabbers
videos.overview: Ethan and Emily are pulled into George Washington’s painting—and a Dark Dumpster Derek movie inside their own imagination—to stop a group of villains from stealing gold before it disappears for good. Sponsored by Goldbacks.
